description: Historische Lagefestpunkte is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geodaten.bayern.de. Historical fixed points are former trigonometric high points such as church spires or summit crosses, which were transferred to the local offices for digitization, broadband and surveying (ÄDBV) as cadastral fixed points in 2004. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Historical locations" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include historische Lagefestpunkte, historische Trigonometrische Punkte, historische Festpunkte, KFP, gdiby, Einzelpunktnachweis. The listing shows 1 download or service links in PDF. The listing shows 2024-07-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
